name: TalentXperience 2026

plan.title: Check in and qualify attendance
plan.detail: Is full attendance or the two-talk instruction compulsory for my programme, or is it only the passport/lunch challenge? Which company representatives here can shortlist engineering candidates? Is Rezonate’s engineering or hiring representative available before 11:30? Check-in timing is a recommendation and depends on the queue.

plan.title: Ailytics
plan.detail: Ask about the junior DevOps role, engineering ownership, practical networking expectations and the required placement/work-pass route. Seek a named technical follow-up.

plan.title: Ajentik AI
plan.detail: Find out whether a funded junior or internship project exists. Lead with TalkToIt and ResearchAgent; move on if it is only an unspecified expression of interest.

plan.title: Move to Level 4
plan.detail: Allow travel and queue time. Swap the first two booths if one has a long queue.

plan.title: Fano Labs
plan.detail: Qualify the four-month internship, implementation-versus-presales split, non-credit/work-pass route and person who owns shortlisting.

plan.title: Exit decision
plan.location: Finish notes / leave if no concrete next step needs you
plan.detail: At about 10:15, leave once the three core conversations are complete and you have the available next steps. By about 10:20, leave unless a relevant hiring person has agreed to a specific near-term conversation or staff confirm an attendance obligation. Do not add booths or talks just to earn lunch.

plan.title: Extend for a real hiring conversation
plan.location: A specific team representative / confirmed location
plan.detail: The briefing lists Rezonate only at the 11:30–12:00 Inspire talk, with no booth. Ask staff for an earlier introduction; there is no confirmed early availability. Do not wait an extra hour solely for a presentation. Extend for a confirmed hiring contact or if you deliberately choose to investigate this strongest-fit role.

plan.title: Lunch · skip by default
plan.detail: Lunch redemption is documented; no lunch recruiting or interview block is advertised. Stay only by choice or for a specifically arranged relevant meeting.

source_note: Booths and talks follow the supplied student briefing, physical pages 7–8. The public event page currently lists a different talk programme and a different organisation name in place of Octomate; confirm signage on arrival. The briefing prints 11:30–12:00 AM for the final sessions; shown here as midday within the stated morning event.
after_event: CV submission and internship interviews take place after TalentXperience. Check ITS for submission instructions; shortlisted students are invited for interviews.

plan_summary: Short visit · three core booths · leave by about 10:20 unless a concrete hiring conversation or attendance obligation justifies staying.
